newsitem.title: USA: CSCE sugar called to open flat to slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: CSCE sugar called to open flat to slightly lower.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open unchanged to 0.05 cent lower as the London market drifted lower in technical trading.
The October contract closed Wednesday at 11.67 cents a lb, up 0.06 cents from Tuesday and traded in a range between 11.58 and 11.68 cents. The London October contract was $1.20 off at $325.50.

Sugar trading has been lackluster this week with locals kicking it to and fro, against the backdrop of Brazilian producer hedge selling and large speculative long position, that many believe is due for liquidation.

Syria tendered to buy 13,000 tonnes of whites and 13,000 tonnes of raws for October shipment. The deadline for offers is September 9. It also tendered to buy 13,000 tonnes of white sugar for shipment between September 20 and October 30.
